label: Peters Brook mouth on Baddeck River east bank

reference_mouth_midpoint.method: EPSG3857 midpoint of original northern/southern mouth-bank vertices, transformed back to lonlat. Project-derived centre, not the Gazetteer point.

identity_evidence: The source explicitly labels Peters Brook approaching from the east and entering the eastern bank of the south-flowing Baddeck River, upstream of the separate Baddeck Bridge road crossing. The main river bends southwest below the confluence. Native detail separates the western road from the double-bank river. Select the single-line Peters mouth at the river bank, not the centre of the main channel or either road crossing. Original named Peters banks158509/183270 terminate on Baddeck east-bank segments164867/164868. Modern channel islands are finer detail; no island or modern name point is used as the coordinate.
